title: Early Termination Charges and Notice Across the Storage Programmes
content:
Where a member ends a storage agreement before it has run its shortest term, the programme fixes what that costs and how much notice it takes. This page posts both figures for the six programmes of Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

| Programme | Early termination charge (USD) | Notice to end early (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 0.00 | 0 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 50.00 | 10 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 100.00 | 15 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 0.00 | 0 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 150.00 | 20 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 300.00 | 30 |

## Reading the two columns together

Two programmes post neither a charge nor a notice period: the Open Storage Account, which carries no minimum term at all, and the Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement, whose storage has been bought up front. On the other four the charge and the notice rise together, from 50.00 with 10 days on the Grain Bank Deposit Account to 300.00 with 30 days on the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage.

## Same terms, put as a member would ask them

**What would ending a Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement early cost?** The posted charge on that programme is 150.00, and the notice the programme calls for is 20 calendar days.

**And on an Open Storage Account?** Nothing is posted against either column, so no early termination charge stands and no notice period is fixed.

**Is the notice counted in business days?** No. The notice in this column is counted in calendar days, unlike the load-out notice, which is counted in business days.
